vibe: Clean, minimal, simple white and black. Premium feel, snappy, and dead simple for non-financial users.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for containers to breathe. Minimalist luxury.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Flat solid surfaces, 1px borders.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Center-align hero text or empty states.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_constraints: Images max-h-[80vh]. Stack grids on mobile.

components.general: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts. Use customized Shadcn for interactive logic (dropdowns, forms).
components.surfaces: Cardless or subtle 1px border. Background matches parent (pure white or off-white). Avoid heavy shadows, use crisp borders.
components.tooltips: CRITICAL: Implement Shadcn Tooltip for ALL financial jargon (LTV, CAC, ICP, GP) as requested. Tooltips must be dark gray with white text.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid black with white text. Hover: bg-black/80. Secondary: White bg, 1px black border. Hover: bg-gray-50.
components.inputs: Shadcn input, minimal border. Focus state: ring-2 ring-black. No colored rings.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). Keep it elegant and legible.

motion_and_interactions.general: Framer Motion for page transitions (fade and slight upward slide). Parallax scrolling on landing/dashboard banners.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Snappy but smooth. transition-all duration-200. Buttons scale down slightly (active:scale-95).
motion_and_interactions.modals: Backdrop blur on overlays (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/20). Content slides in from bottom.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA calculator guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='business-switcher').

login_register.layout: Split screen. Left: minimalist brand abstract image. Right: Clean form.

dashboard.features: Business switcher dropdown (like Slack) in the top-left header. Value prop banner prominent at the top. Grid showing one-sentence offers, CAC profit, 30-day GP, 12-month LTV.

unit_economics.features: Define Base/Core/Upsell offers. Input fields for unit definition and costs. 'Save Simulation' button. 'Compare' side-by-side view.

money_models.features: Simple explanations. 'WHEN to offer' timeline. LTV/CAC modeling calculators. 30-day projections based on 'X' customers input.

customer_journey.layout: Horizontal scrolling timeline or vertical stepper.
customer_journey.features: End-to-end journey mapping. Pain points selection. 'Create Offer' button tied to pain points. ICP & Value Prop sticky side panel. 'Export PDF' button.

image_urls.description: A blurry white abstract background for the login screen.
Black and white abstract background with wavy lines, useful for banners or parallax.
Minimalist premium architecture background for empty states or dashboard accents.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Strictly adhere to the black and white minimalist color palette. Do not add colored buttons or gradients.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: All .js files should be used, no .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Crucial: Implement tooltips for all financial terms like LTV, CAC, ICP, GP using Shadcn UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are placed on all interactive elements as requested.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Install framer-motion for the requested animations and parallax scrolling.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Maintain generous padding (p-8, p-12) for a high-end luxury feel.
